text: My birds whisper that Gandalf (1) and Hermione (2) seem to have been lingering near one another’s stalls more than most this morning, and likewise Yoda (3) and Batman (4) have been seen sharing a pot of spiced tea near the eastern brazier. It’s the sort of thing that catches the eye when the bazaar is still finding its rhythm — though of course, birds can mis-see as easily as they can see.
